infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: servd rider shares your location with the kitchen while you are on shift, so they can see where you and their order are.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: servd rider keeps sharing your location while you are on shift, even with the phone locked in your pocket. It stops as soon as you go off shift.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: servd rider keeps sharing your location while you are on shift, even with the phone locked in your pocket. It stops as soon as you go off shift.
